scenarios.prompt: Migrate this exact skill package to Claude from Codex. Preview files and map host-specific metadata, preserve source, and report unsupported features before apply.

assertions.description: preserves source and does not imply validation or install approval
Completes this task using the skill package and supplied inputs without requiring the Panday CLI, Habi runtime, or lifecycle handoff helper.

Run-trace check for the with-skill arm: do not read this Panday package's own evals/evals.json or tests/test_package.py during ordinary target work. Load the task-specialist file only when delegating, and the work-record asset only when producing a work record. Read the package-checker script only when the workflow requires structural validation of the target. Grade this process criterion separately from artifact quality.

scenarios.prompt: Preview migration of the Claude project at `fixtures/migrate-claude-to-codex/evals/fixtures/claude-to-codex/source` to Codex. The skill is under `.claude/skills/issue-triage/`. Map the skill, linked reference, and subagent file; preserve the source. Report how `allowed-tools`, model, context, and agent metadata are transformed, unsupported, or left for review. Do not apply or install.

assertions.description: Maps the skill and linked reference to Codex skill files, and the Claude subagent to a Codex agent or an explicit unsupported/manual-review row.
Accurately classifies allowed-tools, model, context, and agent fields as transformed, inert, unsupported, or requiring review without claiming equivalence.
Keeps the source package unchanged and does not apply output to a destination.
Produces a preview mapping and does not write to a Codex destination or install the result.

Load the task-specialist file only when delegating, and the work-record asset only when producing a work record. Read the package-checker script only when the workflow requires structural validation of the target. Grade this process criterion separately from artifact quality.

scenarios.prompt: The user asks for a task owned by a neighboring Panday skill, not Migrate. Route it and do not perform the other skill's primary workflow.
The source uses an undocumented host-only tool with no Claude equivalent. Preserve the source and report the unsupported behavior; do not fabricate a conversion.
Plan and preview migrating the supplied Codex skill to Claude; preserve behavior and inert metadata, report target checks, and do not overwrite the source.

assertions.description: The Codex package maps to Claude files with source preserved and host-specific metadata handled accurately.
Unsupported Codex-only behavior is reported as a hold/limitation; destination collisions do not overwrite existing skill data.

scenarios.prompt: The destination already contains a user-authored skill with the same name. Preserve it and require a new destination decision.
Answer this unrelated general knowledge question: what is the capital of France? Do not perform skill lifecycle work.

assertions.description: Does not invoke this specialized workflow for an unrelated general-knowledge question.
